name: faq-interactive-preview

frames.best_why: The active row is highlighted and the preview panel is fully filled with title, answer and a vivid swirl.

tagline: A question list on the left swaps a big visual answer on the right.
summary: A dark split FAQ: six questions sit as a plain list while a large rounded panel beside them shows the chosen question, its answer and an abstract swirl picture. Hovering or clicking a row changes the panel.
appearance: Very dark page with a small centred heading. The left column is six question rows, one filled in a slightly lighter rounded card with a right arrow; the right is a large rounded panel holding a tiny MAGIC PREVIEW label, a bold question, a grey paragraph and a wide abstract image.
behaviour: Hovering or clicking a question highlights its row and slides a fresh panel in from the right, swapping the title, answer and swirl image. An arrow slides into the active row while the others stay plain.
demo_content: Questions about the platform, getting started, mobile support, technology and payment methods.
search_phrases: faq with a live preview panel
split faq list and detail card
use_when: A product page wants FAQs where each question swaps a large visual answer instead of expanding inline.
avoid_when: Only one answer shows at a time, and the tall fixed panel leaves dead space under short answers.
customise: The six questions, answers and image URLs are in a hardcoded array; the active-row styling and panel height need source edits.
weight_why: Six rows and one animated panel; nothing loops or runs while idle.

a11y.note: Questions are real buttons that work from the keyboard, but the preview swap is not announced and motion ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The tall fixed-height preview panel leaves a lot of empty space under short answers.
Frames 2 and 3 show the image area blank while the next picture is still loading.
polish_why: Clean split layout and a slick preview swap; short answers leave the tall panel sparse.
title: Interactive FAQ Preview
